It is based on the video game series of the same name and the novels set in the world of Azeroth.  The film stars Travis Fimmel, Paula Patton, Ben Foster, Dominic Cooper, Toby Kebbell, Ben Schnetzer, Robert Kazinsky, Clancy Brown, and Daniel Wu.  The film portrays the initial encounters between the humans and the orcs and takes place in a variety of locations established in the video game series.

Williams.  The film is set in the same universe as the video games but features an original story that expands the series' mythology, taking place during the Spanish Inquisition. Patton made her film debut in the 2005 comedy film "Hitch" and starred in the epic fantasy film "Warcraft" (2016), based on the game series of the same name.  Patton has also been the female lead in "Déjà Vu" (2006), "" (2011) and "2 Guns" (2013), and appeared in the critically acclaimed "Precious" (2009).
